events.verdict: Ellis (SAC) avoids making illegal contact with Jaquez Jr. (MIA) during his driving shot attempt. The contact as Jaquez Jr. returns to the floor is incidental.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up in a screening position in Rozier's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Herro (MIA) does not advance the ball into the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) and Adebayo (MIA) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Highsmith (MIA) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Sabonis's (SAC) wrist before making contact with the ball.
Monk (SAC) moves forwards into Herro's (MIA) space, initiating lower body contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Rozier (MIA) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Murray (SAC) dislodges Herro (MIA) from his rebounding position.
Monk (SAC) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) initiates illegal contact with Highsmith (MIA) that affects his play at the basket.
Highsmith's (MIA) free throw attempt does not make contact with the rim.
Monk's (SAC) shot attempt lands out of bounds.
Rozier (MIA) initiates illegal contact to Monk's (SAC) arm during the driving shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) possession and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) steps into Sabonis's (SAC) path and delivers contact that dislodges him from his position.
DeRozan (SAC) moves forwards into Rozier's (MIA) lower body, affecting his shot attempt.
Highsmith (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Monk's (SAC) drive to the basket before cleanly blocking his shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) commits a take foul on Jaquez Jr. (MIA). After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined to be a common foul.
Adebayo (MIA) is drawn into the air on the closeout and he initiates illegal contact to Ellis's (SAC) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Highsmith (MIA) jumps forwards into DeRozan's (SAC) lower body, initiating illegal contact during his shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) reaches in and makes contact to Adebayo's (MIA) arm, which affects his ability to finish the play at the rim.
Highsmith (MIA) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) and Sabonis (SAC) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Herro (MIA) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
